purpose: Diagnostic same-binary label/order control, never an adoption dataset
rust_labels: Both baseline and candidate execute the exact same baseline-sdf path and bytes
comparator: Same Open Babel SDK binary, third arm retained
data: Unfiltered sdf-0 1000-record corpus, all parse/write/roundtrip modes in original order
conditions: Identical 500ms warmup, 100ms minimum timing and per-batch normalization

designs.name: balanced
designs.orders: all six permutations, shuffled once with fixed seed20261017, four complete cycles

interpretation: A nonunit ratio for identical binaries can reveal label/order or environment bias; a null result does not prove the candidate slowdown is code layout. Preserve every observation.
